dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Mushroom Rock Road. Feels like a lifetime ago.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Someone is calling an aeon. Here, now.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Not calling. Forcing.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Two of them. I know those shapes.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Sandy and Mindy. Wearing the wrong colours.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Yevon's doing, ya? Even our friends, now.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Then we send them properly.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Together. Like always.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: That was only the road.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Only?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Yevon has a second summoner waiting below.
Deep in the cavern, a blade was already drawn.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: His blade is ready. Call an aeon, now!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Rest now. All of you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: He fought like a man who was paid.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Wasn't it his own blade, though?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: No. Someone borrowed it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: And the sisters?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: They came when I called. They will again.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: That's the real thing, ya. The mirror was just a trick.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Go on. The road is still long.
